plan.title: Content Ki Length Barhaen (Word Count Expand Karein)
plan.detail: Muqabla karne wali sites par average 2286 words hain jabke aap ki site par sirf 331 words hain. Target keywords ko detail mein cover karein, FAQs add karein, aur word count ko kam se kam 1500-2000 words tak le jaen taake search engines aap ko topical authority samajhein.

plan.title: Images Aur Media Add Karein
plan.detail: Aap ki site par filhal 0 images hain jabke competitors ke paas average 77 images hain. High-quality, compressed images aur infographics add karein aur un mein proper alt tags (keywords ke sath) use karein taake image SEO behtar ho aur bounce rate kam ho.

plan.title: Internal Linking Structure Strong Karein
plan.detail: Competitors ke paas 153 internal links hain jabke aap ki site par sirf 5 hain. Apne relevant blog posts, product pages, aur categories ko aapas mein link karein taake link juice flow ho sake aur crawlability behtar ho.

plan.title: Headings (H2, H3) Ki Structure Behtar Karein
plan.detail: Aap ki site par sirf 5 H2 headings hain jabke competitors average 10 H2 headings use kar rahe hain. Content ko organize karne ke liye mazeed H2 aur H3 subheadings shamil karein aur un mein LSI (related) keywords add karein.

plan.title: Title Tags Aur Meta Description Optimize Karein
plan.detail: Apne main pages ke Titles (50-60 characters) aur Meta Descriptions (150-160 characters) ko secondary keywords aur Call-to-Action (CTA) ke sath rewrite karein taake Search Engine Results Pages (SERP) par Click-Through Rate (CTR) barhe.

plan.title: Schema Markup (Structured Data) Implement Karein
plan.detail: Rich Snippets hasil karne ke liye Article, FAQ, ya Product Schema markup add karein. Is se search engines ko aap ke content ki structure samajhne mein madad milegi.

plan.title: Content Strategy Aur Freshness Par Focus Karein
plan.detail: Chunke site ki speed aur technical SEO score 100/100 hai, is liye tamam focus naye aur trend-based topics par quality content publish karne aur purane content ko regularly update karne par rakhein.
